prompt: Character design sheet of collectible designer-toy style AI agent characters for a team collaboration app, rendered as soft matte 3D vinyl figures with gentle studio lighting. Front and center, larger: the house mascot, a rounded cube character with big glossy expressive eyes, a calm curious expression, and a short antenna topped by a small glowing amber bead. Behind it, a neat row of six smaller companion agents in the same family, each a rounded cube or rounded capsule body in a different muted color (sage, cobalt, coral, lilac, sand, slate) with the same eye style and one small accessory hinting at its job: headphones, a tiny wrench, round glasses, a pencil, a clipboard, a little lantern. Deep warm charcoal background, soft contact shadows. No text, no letters, no logos.
